title: asplenium × microdon
intro: Asplenium × microdon, commonly known as the Maidenhair spleenwort, is a hybrid species of fern in the Aspleniaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Asplenium × microdon are attributed to its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it useful in treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
